facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports that the DARE1 cable system currently links Djibouti City with Bosaso and Mogadishu in Somalia and Mombasa in Kenya, with 36 Tbit/s over three fibre pairs (published 2025-09-01; no start date given in this document).

systems.platform: subsea cable, three fibre pairs, 36 Tbit/s

note: Planned Mombasa-to-Mtunzini extension (start 2026, ready 2028) is announced by the company as a plan; no agreement stated, so no fact for it.
